kwh_source: dataset export: household electricity_kwh and gas_kwh (annual, calendar 2024)
expenditure_price_basis: DESNZ Quarterly Energy Prices CY2024, regional average unit cost plus fixed cost, including 5% VAT, all payment methods

dataset_energy_levels.elec_basis: ONS Consumer Trends 2024 electricity spending £28.13bn at the QEP UK price
dataset_energy_levels.gas_basis: DESNZ Energy Trends domestic gas, calendar 2024

tariff_coverage: All households on capped variable tariffs (Ofgem GB direct-debit averages); fixed tariffs, payment method and contract expiry not modelled. Northern Ireland on GB prices as a proxy.
